about: Every asset sheet in this folder: frames run left to right, then down, in w x h cells (cols x rows). anchor is the point that sits on the ground tile or the character; opacity (if any) is already in the PNG's alpha. groundOverlays says which frame of the "-shapes" overlay sheets fits each ground tile of ground.png, by its column-row.
